newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures steady to lower in after-hours.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures steady to lower in after-hours.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were flat to easier in after-hours trade on Friday after active short-covering in the spot December contract led the rally during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.3 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark May was 0.1 yen weaker at 145.8 yen.

During the day, prices were supported by rain in Thailand which disrupted the tapping process and a view that deliveries at the spot expiry next week would be small. "The market may have more room to rise. But the key is whether rain in Thailand will be prolonged," one trader said.
